# hallpass_api_access_profile (Resource)

An access profile of an API target: which requests agents may make through the API proxy. Agents request it like a role; `hallpass_policy_rule` decides who may and whether it is approved automatically. Set its credential with `hallpass_api_credential`. A request is allowed when an allow rule matches and no deny rule does; matching is case-insensitive. Destroying it deletes the profile: access ends and its credential is destroyed. Import with the role ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reads, and GraphQL queries (gh uses GraphQL for most commands).
resource "hallpass_api_access_profile" "read" {
  server_id = hallpass_api_target.github.id
  alias     = "read"
  rules = [
    { effect = "allow", methods = ["GET", "HEAD"] },
    { effect = "allow", methods = ["POST"], paths = ["/graphql"], graphql = ["query"] },
    { effect = "deny", paths = ["/user/keys", "/user/keys/**", "/authorizations/**"] },
  ]
}

# Comments and labels on acme's issues, approved by a person each time.
resource "hallpass_api_access_profile" "issues" {
  server_id = hallpass_api_target.github.id
  alias     = "issues"
  rules = [
    { effect = "allow", methods = ["POST"], paths = ["/repos/acme/*/issues/*/comments", "/repos/acme/*/issues/*/labels"] },
  ]
  max_duration = "1h"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) Profile name, unique on the target.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Allow and deny rules (at least one allow rule). Empty lists match anything. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `server_id` (String) API target ID (`srv_…`). Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `approvals_required` (Number) Distinct approvers each request needs (1-5). Above 1, policy never approves automatically and any one denial ends the request.
- `default_duration` (String) Access duration when the agent does not ask for one. A duration such as `30m` or `4h`.
- `description` (String) Description, shown to operators.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the profile is enabled. Disabling ends active access within seconds and cancels pending requests; enabling lets policy decide again.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels of the profile, used by policy selectors.
- `max_duration` (String) Longest access an agent may request (policy may lower it). A duration such as `30m` or `4h`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Profile ID (`rol_…`).

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `effect` (String) `allow` or `deny`.

Optional:

- `graphql` (Set of String) Match GraphQL requests by operation type (`query`, `mutation`, `subscription`). An allow rule matches only when every operation is of a listed type; a deny rule when any is, or when they cannot be determined.
- `hosts` (Set of String) Hosts of the target the rule applies to (exact or `*.domain`).
- `methods` (Set of String) HTTP methods (`GET`, `HEAD`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`, `OPTIONS`).
- `paths` (Set of String) Path patterns starting with `/`: `*` matches within one segment, `**` any number of segments, `{a,b}` either alternative. An escaped slash stays inside its segment.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hallpass_api_access_profile.read rol_01hzxv3k4f8m9q2r5t7w0y6c1a
```
